samurai_right_full.png:
Qiuqiu, a chibi grey tabby cat: light grey fur with darker grey stripes, a WHITE face, white chest and white paws, pink inner ears, big round dark eyes with glossy white highlights, small pink blush strokes on both cheeks, a NAVY BLUE headband with two long trailing tails. Head about as big as the whole body, short stubby limbs, no neck - the same cat as in the reference image.

Wearing full ceremonial O-YOROI samurai armour exactly as in the reference image: deep red lacquered scale plates laced with cords, big square shoulder guards (o-sode), a horned kabuto helmet with a golden crescent crest pushed back so the navy headband still shows, and a small back banner on a pole behind his shoulder. Full body, side three-quarter view FACING RIGHT - he looks and steps toward the right edge of the picture - standing in a ready battle stance, feet at the very bottom of the frame, filling the frame from top to bottom. Nothing else in the picture: no ground, no shadow, no scenery, no text, no border. Exactly ONE character.
Style: thick black outlines, FLAT colours with only subtle soft shading - not painterly. Cute cartoon. Background must be plain solid WHITE.
If any enemy appears, it is a small grey rat or a small orange tabby bandit cat - NEVER another copy of the hero and never anything that looks like him. Enemies stay small and near the edges so the hero is clearly the main subject filling the centre.

Output 1024x1024 PNG. Save the image as samurai_right_full.png in the current directory and report the path.
